aiEnriched.tagline: Precision Cuts & Classic Shaves in Brooklyn
aiEnriched.heroDescription: Experience Brooklyn's top-rated barbering experience. Rated 4.9 stars by 180+ loyal locals. Walk in today or call to book your appointment.
aiEnriched.aboutText: Crown Heights Master Barbershop blends timeless grooming craftsmanship with modern styling. Whether you need a crisp fade, scissor cut, or traditional hot lather shave, our master barbers ensure you leave looking your absolute best.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment or do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: We welcome walk-ins every day! However, on Friday and Saturday, booking ahead by phone ensures minimal wait time.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept Cash, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and all major Credit/Debit cards.
